name: StellaCodex Post Carousel
author: stellacodex

sections.description:
StellaCodex Post Carousel lets you select WordPress posts, arrange them visually, and display them with a shortcode.

Free features include unlimited carousels, manual post selection (search, add from a category, add by URL), drag-and-drop ordering, left/right arrow navigation, responsive card counts, and design controls (cards per view, border, corner radius, image ratio, card title and date).

Pro adds automatic sources (latest posts, a category, or a tag), autoplay (one-card and page-by-page) and continuous scrolling, auto-insert of a carousel at the end of post content (all posts or selected categories / tags), and carousel categories for organizing your carousels.

The free version is fully usable without a license and has no carousel-count limit.

External services

This plugin includes the Freemius SDK for optional usage analytics, Pro licensing, checkout, and Pro updates. Free users can skip the opt-in and continue using the plugin. No usage data is sent before an administrator explicitly opts in. When a user purchases or activates Pro, the plugin communicates with Freemius to provide licensing, payments, and updates.

Freemius terms of service: https://freemius.com/terms/
Freemius privacy policy: https://freemius.com/privacy/
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin ZIP from Plugins > Add New > Upload Plugin.
  2. Activate StellaCodex Post Carousel.
  3. Open Post Carousels in the WordPress dashboard.
  4. Create a carousel and paste its shortcode into a post or page.
sections.faq:
How do I display a carousel?

Create a carousel under “Post Carousels” in the WordPress dashboard, then copy its shortcode (for example [stellacodex_carousel id="s1"]) and paste it into any post or page.

Can I choose which posts appear?

Yes. In the free version you select posts manually and drag to reorder them. Pulling posts automatically from the latest posts, a category, or a tag is a Pro feature.

What is the difference between “Add from a category” and a Pro automatic category source?

“Add from a category” is a free editing shortcut: it copies the posts that are currently in that WordPress category into your manual list. A Pro automatic category source stays connected to the category and updates the carousel when posts are added later.

How many carousels can I create in the free version?

The free version lets you create an unlimited number of carousels.

Does it work with standard WordPress themes?

Yes. The carousel uses a shortcode and is designed to work with standard WordPress themes. No coding is required.

Can I change the heading level or hide the title?

Yes. The shortcode accepts optional attributes, for example [stellacodex_carousel id="s1" tag="h3"] to set the carousel heading level, or [stellacodex_carousel id="s1" title="hide"] to hide the heading above the carousel. Card-title visibility is controlled in Settings.

What does the Pro version add?

Automatic sources (latest posts, a category, or a tag), autoplay and continuous scrolling, auto-insert at the end of post content (all posts or selected categories / tags), and carousel categories for organizing carousels.
